title: Hybrid Tool Execution — Direct vs Claude CLI routing
source_plan: user request 2026-04-22 — implement smart hybrid approach with comprehensive tests
notes: direct_tools.py exists with execute_direct() for simple tools, but ActionWorker still routes everything through Claude CLI. This phase wires in the fast path and adds comprehensive test coverage.

stories.title: Wire direct_tools into ActionWorker
stories.description: ActionWorker._process_one checks _is_simple_tool() and routes: simple tools → execute_direct(), complex tools → Claude CLI. Settings passed for workspace_dir.
acceptanceCriteria: src/actions.py imports execute_direct and _is_simple_tool from direct_tools module
ActionWorker._process_one has if/else branching: if _is_simple_tool(intent.tool) call execute_direct() else call claude_cli.call_action()
execute_direct receives settings from self.claude_cli.settings or equivalent
execute_direct result dict converted to summary string for on_result callback
Error cases handled: execute_direct success=false → on_error called with exception
Logging added: direct execution path logs 'DIRECT EXECUTION tool=%s', Claude path logs 'CLAUDE CLI tool=%s'

stories.title: Test direct tool execution paths
stories.description: Comprehensive unit tests for each simple tool: bash, read, write, web_fetch, web_search. Mock subprocess, filesystem, HTTP.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/test_direct_tools.py exists with test class for each tool
test_bash_success: mock subprocess, assert returncode=0, success=true, output captured
test_bash_timeout: asyncio.TimeoutError raised, assert success=false, error='Command timed out'
test_bash_stderr: mock subprocess with stderr, assert error field contains stderr
test_read_success: create temp file, assert content matches
test_read_not_found: non-existent path, assert success=false, error contains 'File not found'
test_read_large_file: 200k file, assert content truncated to 100k with '... (truncated)' suffix
test_read_workspace_relative: settings with workspace_dir, relative path resolved correctly
test_write_success: path:content format, assert file created, parent dirs created
test_write_no_colon: missing colon in args, assert success=false, error='requires path: content format'
test_write_workspace_relative: relative path resolved to workspace_dir
test_web_fetch_success: mock httpx with text response, assert output=response.text
test_web_fetch_binary: mock httpx with binary content, assert output='[Binary response, N bytes]'
test_web_fetch_large: mock 100k response, assert truncated to 50k
test_web_fetch_http_error: mock httpx.HTTPStatusError, assert success=false, error contains status code
test_web_fetch_invalid_url: url without http/https, assert success=false, error='must start with'
test_web_search_brave_success: mock httpx Brave API, assert results extracted as '- title: url' format
test_web_search_brave_no_results: mock empty response, assert 'No results found'
test_web_search_no_api_key: unset BRAVE_API_KEY, assert success=false, error='requires BRAVE_API_KEY'
test_web_search_brave_failure: mock httpx error, assert fallback to 'Brave search failed'

stories.title: Test ActionWorker routing logic
stories.description: Integration tests verifying ActionWorker routes tools correctly: simple tools bypass Claude, complex tools go through Claude CLI. Mock both execute_direct and claude_cli.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/test_actions_routing.py exists (or added to tests/test_actions.py)
test_simple_tool_routes_to_direct: Intent with tool='bash' → execute_direct called, claude_cli.call_action NOT called
test_read_tool_routes_to_direct: Intent with tool='read' → execute_direct called
test_write_tool_routes_to_direct: Intent with tool='write' → execute_direct called
test_web_fetch_routes_to_direct: Intent with tool='web_fetch' → execute_direct called
test_web_search_routes_to_direct: Intent with tool='web_search' → execute_direct called
test_edit_tool_routes_to_claude: Intent with tool='edit' → claude_cli.call_action called, execute_direct NOT called
test_mcp_tool_routes_to_claude: Intent with tool='mcp__github__create_issue' → claude_cli.call_action called
test_direct_success_calls_on_result: execute_direct returns success=true → on_result callback invoked with summary
test_direct_failure_calls_on_error: execute_direct returns success=false → on_error callback invoked with exception
test_direct_result_format: execute_direct dict with output='hello' → on_result receives 'hello' as summary
test_claude_path_unchanged: Intent with tool='edit' → existing Claude flow unchanged, summary extracted from result['summary']

stories.title: Test _is_simple_tool classification
stories.description: Unit tests for _is_simple_tool function verifying correct classification of tools.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/test_direct_tools.py has test_is_simple_tool function
test_bash_is_simple: _is_simple_tool('bash') returns True
test_read_is_simple: _is_simple_tool('read') returns True
test_write_is_simple: _is_simple_tool('write') returns True
test_web_fetch_is_simple: _is_simple_tool('web_fetch') returns True
test_web_search_is_simple: _is_simple_tool('web_search') returns True
test_edit_is_not_simple: _is_simple_tool('edit') returns False
test_mcp_tool_is_not_simple: _is_simple_tool('mcp__github__create_issue') returns False
test_mcp_filesystem_is_not_simple: _is_simple_tool('mcp__filesystem__read_file') returns False
test_unknown_tool_is_not_simple: _is_simple_tool('unknown') returns False
